items.title: EnsLib.AI.Agent.OutboundAdapter ignores the model in its ProviderConfig; the provider default (claude-sonnet-5, max_tokens 131072) is sent
Agent runs a tool call from a response that stopped at max_tokens, and Chat() reports only the last stop reason
Session timeout_ms does not stop a slow provider request: Chat returns after 20 s with timeout_ms = 3000
%AI.Provider silently retries HTTP 429 and 503 (4 requests per Chat), with no setting and no signal to the caller
%AI.Tool generates an unquoted call for a valid quoted underscore method (154U)

Agent tool loop in EnsLib.AI.Agent.PassthroughOperation has no default bound and keeps running after the caller's SendRequestSync timeout
An empty assistant turn is sent back without `content`, so the next `Chat()` in the session fails with HTTP 400 on Ollama
Provider errors that AI Hub recognises (model not found, billing, timeout) are thrown as <%AICore>ProviderError instead of their dedicated codes
OpenAI-compatible providers drop finish_reason: a reply cut at the token limit looks like a complete answer
